main_text.p: His omnibus adjungi possent complures aliæ Epistolæ , quas mihi communicavit vir pietate & eruditione conspicuus Dionysius Amelotus, Congregationis Oratorii Presbyter , & ex quibus non pauca in hanc Morini vitam transtuli ; sed juvat etiam, mox recensita opuscula illustrare : Haud dubiè Morinus in animo habuerat tractatum de Basilicis & earum partibus edere ad Calcem Libri sui de ordinationibus , ut ipsemet testatur in Epistola ad Cardi-

page.notes: The word "eruditione" is followed by a small printed stroke, possibly a mark or a broken hyphen; it is not clear what it signals. "Aquintais" is uncertain: the scan is weak at this word. "Jay" is printed with a J-shaped letter; read as Jay. The italic long s is printed as a letter resembling f; read as s throughout. The catchword "nalem" and signature "F 4" are at the foot. The page is set in roman and italic with no marginal notes.
